description: Source code for managing raft stream communication over HTTP in etcd, including stream types, connection handling, and message decoding/encoding.

classes.name: outgoingConn
classes.description: Represents an outgoing connection with stream type and I/O interfaces.

classes.name: streamWriter
classes.description: Handles writing messages over a network stream, managing connection lifecycle and message encoding.

classes.name: streamReader
classes.description: Handles reading messages from a network stream, including connection establishment, decoding, and rate limiting.

methods.name: startStreamWriter
methods.description: Creates and starts a streamWriter goroutine for sending raft messages.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for streamWriter, handling connection state, message sending, and heartbeats.

methods.name: writec
methods.description: Returns the channel for sending raft messages.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream connection and resets message channel.

methods.name: closeUnlocked
methods.description: Performs the actual closing of the connection, called within lock.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new outgoing connection to the streamWriter.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the streamReader goroutine for reading raft messages.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for streamReader, handling connection establishment, decoding, and retries.

methods.name: decodeLoop
methods.description: Decodes incoming messages from the stream and dispatches them to appropriate channels.

methods.name: dial
methods.description: Establishes a network connection to the peer for streaming, handling HTTP request/response and version compatibility.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses message processing in the streamReader.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes message processing in the streamReader.

methods.name: checkStreamSupport
methods.description: Checks if a stream type is supported in a given semantic version.
